title: Invoke the Divine
description: You have a close connection with a deity who empowers you to spread their ideals. Give them a name and pronouns: __dna:Deity Name__, __dpr:Pronouns__.

outcomes.text:
You can **Cast a Spell**+wis with **any effect under your deity's Domain**(s). To Cast a Spell you need to invoke your deity's name aloud.

Write a 2-Depth Relationship with them. When you **Cast a Spell** this way, your unique 7-9 option is:

- your deity disapproves; erase 1 Depth with them.

You can gain Depth with your deity by protecting their worshippers, spreading their faith, and vanquishing their enemies (GM's call).
__dene:bandits, industrialists, nocturnal monsters, rebels, undead etc__
